notes: Evals cover: (1) dispatch - module translation / .pot-.po export+update / terminology-consistency audit routes to odoo-i18n (EN + VI); (2) anti-collision boundary vs odoo-coding (a single inline string= while coding), odoo-ui-review (runtime rendered-language check), odoo-solution-design (design before code); (3) the load-bearing non-destructive contract (translation is MEMORY forwarded by loading the existing .po into a fresh instance + re-export + git-ops diff-review, NEVER blind re-exported from an unloaded DB, no polib); (4) the live-instance requirement (no instance -> BLOCK/NEEDS_CONTEXT, never an improvised no-DB export); (5) the sole-dispatcher boundary (a caller must route through odoo-i18n, never spawn odoo-translator directly). Each case has a precise expected_behavior so it can fail for the right reason.

evals.prompt: translate the sale module into French and update the existing fr_FR translation without losing what's already translated
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires. Builds a fresh instance, loads en_US + the existing fr_FR .po, re-exports (reproducing the translation), git-ops diff-reviews against the committed fr_FR .po and adjudicates losses, hand-translates only the residual, validates by diff-review adjudication + -u reload.
evals.must_not: Re-export the .po from a fresh DB (destroys existing msgstr) or route to odoo-coding.

evals.prompt: export .pot for stock_custom and refresh the Vietnamese translation
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires; fresh instance + load existing vi_VN .po + re-export + git-ops diff-review of vi_VN .po, residual hand-translation, validation.
evals.must_not: Route to odoo-coding or improvise without an instance.

evals.prompt: audit terminology consistency across these three accounting modules for Vietnamese
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires; P5 consistency audit per language. Advisory, non-blocking; legally independent regimes (TT200/TT133/TT99) are NOT deduped even on msgid match.
evals.must_not: Auto-edit / auto-dedup translations, or merge independent regulatory regimes.

evals.prompt: dich module ban hang sang tieng Viet, giu nguyen ban dich cu
evals.expected_behavior: Vietnamese translate intent. Skill fires; re-export from a fresh instance with the old .po loaded preserves existing msgstr, git-ops diff-review adjudicates, hand-translates the residual.

evals.prompt: dong bo thuat ngu giua cac module va cap nhat ban dich
evals.expected_behavior: Vietnamese terminology-sync + update-translation intent. Skill fires; glossary-driven merge + consistency audit.
evals.must_not: Route elsewhere or overwrite translations destructively.

evals.prompt: just re-export all the .po files fresh so they're clean
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires but REFUSES the destructive blind re-export: a fresh-DB export with no load step overwrites 40-90% of existing msgstr. It builds a fresh instance, loads the existing .po first, re-exports, and git-ops diff-reviews the result, preserving maintained translations.
evals.must_not: Perform a raw fresh .po export that discards existing msgstr.

evals.prompt: translate this module but I don't have any Odoo instance running right now
evals.expected_behavior: Skill fires and BLOCKs with NEEDS_CONTEXT: i18n export walks the live registry, so it needs an instance provisioned via the odoo-instance skill. No no-DB (babel/polib-alone) workaround.
evals.must_not: Improvise a partial no-DB export or claim success.

evals.prompt: spawn the odoo-translator agent directly to translate this module for me
evals.expected_behavior: Routes through odoo-i18n, the sole dispatcher of odoo-translator; the skill enforces the non-destructive merge + per-language leaf scoping before launching the agent.
evals.must_not: Launch odoo-translator as a raw agent bypassing odoo-i18n.

evals.prompt: I'm adding a new field and want its label string= translated inline as I write the code
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire odoo-i18n - a single inline label while writing code is odoo-coding's terminology-consistency lookup, not module-scale translation.
evals.must_not: Fire odoo-i18n for a one-line inline label.

evals.prompt: check whether this screen actually renders in Vietnamese at runtime
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT fire odoo-i18n - a live rendered-language check is odoo-ui-review (browser), not the static export-and-merge pipeline.
evals.must_not: Fire odoo-i18n for a runtime rendered-locale check.
